summary.text: Gary Taylor is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 8 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democratic incumbent Sherae'a Moore.
He won the Republican primary on September 15, 2026, defeating Watara Heath, 79.8% to 20.2% in unofficial totals.
